'''Action boots''' were a type of [[Boot/Legends|boot]]. [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] wore action boots during the events surrounding the collapse of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] wore this kind of boot during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
